People: Samuel Hopkins (author, Wikidata Q94131692), died 1755. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Hopkins, Samuel, 1693-1755") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Historical memoirs, relating to the Housa tunnuk Indians: or, an account of the methods used, and pains taken, for the propagation of the gospel among that heathenish-tribe, ... under the ministry of the late Reverend Mr. John Sergeant: together with the character of that eminently worthy missionary; ... By Samuel Hopkins, ...  1753, 1753, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_historical-memoirs-rela_hopkins-samuel-ministe_1753. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 81%, 65%, 80% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Samuel Hopkins, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
